purpose: Walkable reference gallery of every Unstructured template, including clearly labeled modular sections. No production village selection or runtime mod installation.

source.distribution: Source jar, original templates and edited display copies remain private under ignored run/. Public record contains provenance and placement metadata only. The bundled MIT license names TelepathicGrunt and is not treated as permission to redistribute the structure artwork.

preparation: Native Minecraft structure data migration to 1.21.1. All source block namespaces are vanilla.
Jigsaws resolved to their final block state; spawners, command blocks, structure blocks and TNT removed.
Containers emptied and loot metadata removed; source entities stripped, with four decorative item frames recreated separately.
Leaves made persistent and sign click actions removed.
Added 109 invisible supports to keep unsupported decorative details and the trap floor intact. Restored the original lava beneath the stabilized floor.

acceptedLiveChanges.reason: A working piston moved one stone brick east and water filled its former cell. The stone brick remains present at its destination.

preservation: Existing galleries and user-edited exhibits remain in place. Added one travel sign to an empty cell at the original gallery hub.
